LanguageData.YASB_Settings_CharmRange_Desc: Defines the minimum and maximum PawnBeauty stat that will be used in calculations. High values allow extreme traits to have a greater impact.
LanguageData.YASB_Settings_PersonalCap_Desc: The maximum beauty bonus a pawn can get from their own charm and social skill. Default: 180.
LanguageData.YASB_Settings_ObservedCap_Desc: The maximum beauty bonus a pawn can get from seeing other beautiful pawns around them. Default: 240.
LanguageData.YASB_Settings_Radius_Desc: How far away a pawn can be to affect another's perceived beauty. Smaller values improve performance slightly. Default: 8.
LanguageData.YASB_Settings_AllowNegative_Desc: If enabled, pawns with very low charm or social skill can generate negative beauty, making their surroundings uglier.
